name: ai-engineer-tools
description: Ascenda developer telemetry and pairing tooling monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:tools
scripts.build:shared: npm run compile -w @ascenda-one/tool-contract && npm run compile -w @ascenda-one/tool-kit && npm run compile -w @ascenda-one/ide-extension-core
scripts.build:tools: npm run compile -w ascenda && npm run build -w @ascenda-one/claude-code-hooks && npm run build -w @ascenda-one/codex-hooks && npm run build -w @ascenda-one/cursor-hooks && npm run build -w @ascenda-one/windsurf-hooks && npm run build -w @ascenda-one/gemini-hooks && npm run build -w @ascenda-one/agent-mcp && npm run build -w @ascenda-one/github-collector && npm run build -w ascenda-pairing-sim && npm run build -w ascenda-dev-server
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
